verdict.rationale: Lovable's Mintlify-hosted API reference is rendered from its OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec. Endpoint pages include an interactive "Try it" runner and generated cURL samples, so the reference is both explorable and runnable. The docs-path OpenAPI probe 404s do not contradict this, because the spec is served from api.lovable.dev. Executing requests requires a workspace API key, which needs a Business or Enterprise plan. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works, runnable examples on lower-tier plans, and evidence of language samples beyond cURL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify API reference runs the interactive playground: endpoint pages render a "Try it" runner (GET https://api.lovable.dev/v1/workspaces) with generated cURL samples carrying the Lovable-API-Key header.
The docs reference pages render from the same spec.
